scripts.build:native: cd crates/rlmx-napi && npx napi build --platform --release --features napi
scripts.build:wasm: wasm-pack build crates/rlmx-wasm --target web --out-dir ../../packages/wasm --out-name aix_wasm -- --features wasm
scripts.build: npm run build:native && npm run build:wasm && npm run build:ts
scripts.test: npm run test:rust && npm run test:ts
